profile cal-alice flags=(attach_disconnected) {
  / r,
  /** r,
  /usr/lib/** mr,
  /lib/** mr,
  owner /home/alice/** rwkl,
  owner /tmp/** rwkl,
  owner /var/tmp/** rwkl,
  owner /dev/shm/** rwkl,
  /dev/null rw,
  /dev/zero rw,
  /dev/urandom r,
  /dev/random r,
  /dev/tty rw,
  /dev/pts/** rw,
  /run/cal.sock rw,
  network inet stream,
  network inet6 stream,
  network inet dgram,
  network inet6 dgram,
  network unix,
  signal (receive),
  signal (send) peer=cal-alice,
  ptrace (read,trace) peer=cal-alice,
  /usr/bin/bash mrix,
  /usr/bin/cat mrix,
  /usr/bin/chmod mrix,
  /usr/bin/cp mrix,
  /usr/bin/curl mrix,
  /usr/bin/dash mrix,
  /usr/bin/date mrix,
  /usr/bin/dd mrix,
  /usr/bin/env mrix,
  /usr/bin/false mrix,
  /usr/bin/gzip mrix,
  /usr/bin/head mrix,
  /usr/bin/id mrix,
  /usr/bin/jq mrix,
  /usr/bin/ls mrix,
  /usr/bin/mkdir mrix,
  /usr/bin/mv mrix,
  /usr/bin/printf mrix,
  /usr/bin/pwd mrix,
  /usr/bin/readlink mrix,
  /usr/bin/rm mrix,
  /usr/bin/rmdir mrix,
  /usr/bin/sha256sum mrix,
  /usr/bin/sleep mrix,
  /usr/bin/sort mrix,
  /usr/bin/stat mrix,
  /usr/bin/tail mrix,
  /usr/bin/tar mrix,
  /usr/bin/tee mrix,
  /usr/bin/timeout mrix,
  /usr/bin/touch mrix,
  /usr/bin/tr mrix,
  /usr/bin/true mrix,
  /usr/bin/uniq mrix,
  /usr/bin/unzip mrix,
  /usr/bin/wc mrix,
  /usr/local/bin/calctl mrix,
}

profile cal-root-program /usr/local/lib/cal/worker flags=(attach_disconnected) {
  /** r,
  /usr/lib/** mr,
  /lib/** mr,
  /var/lib/cal/active/** rwk,
  /dev/null rw,
  /dev/pts/** rw,
  /usr/local/lib/cal/worker mrix,
}
